page.claimBody: Find your name among the results and claim it. Your finishes, PBs and power score then live here.

welcome.title: Is this you?
welcome.intro: We found {count, plural, one {a runner} other {runners}} matching your name. Claim your profile to own your race history.

strava.promptTitle: Connect Strava to unlock training analytics
strava.promptBody: Track fitness, form, weekly load, heart-rate zones, pace trends, race predictions and more, synced automatically from your runs.

detrained.hint: Too much rest. Load up before fitness drops

fresh.hint: Good day for intervals or a race

mix.note: Classified by pace relative to your median. 80/20 rule: most runs should be easy.
